title: 5.1 Extreme Values of a Function

icans: I can tell absolute extrema from local extrema.
I can find the critical numbers of a function.
I can find the absolute maximum and minimum of a continuous function on a closed interval.

vocab: f(c) ≥ f(x) for every x in the __________

a number c in the __________ where f′(c) = 0 or f′(c) does not exist
